target_build.scope:
Build isolated real SH4 world direct-boundary + uncontended KOS fixtures.

The complete native_ui TU is compiled after replacing only load() and
stream_open() with explicit controlled cold edges. Hot renderer/cache/packet
code and actual KOS sq/mutex/genwait/MMU functions are retained. No vertex
transform/emission, game frame, storage I/O, scheduler contention or PVR wait
is priced by this fixture.

target_cost.scope:
Execute real compiled world direct boundaries and uncontended KOS locks.

These are synthetic instruction traces, not a game frame or console result.
The modeled CPU cost includes actual SQ/mutex/empty-wait-queue/MMU code, with
perfect data cache and no bus, DMA, SQ backpressure, IRQ or scheduling events.
Only the direct boundary is measured: static-world replay/emission is excluded.

UI, KOS, libc, geometry and real PVR scheduling/contended mutex costs are outside this review.
Counts apply to the reviewed primary production configuration and successful normal replay path.
This cannot be subtracted directly from a cycle benchmark or establish net r101 frame time.
